issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Water Fund 68,434.54; Sewer Fund 42,889.86
issues.issue: Printed only as 'Local Receipts: Other'; the extractor assumed water/sewer charges. If that assumption is kept, the user rule (2026-10-28) category is Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees (also receipts[12]).
Street Fund spending printed on the General Government line; kept as general government (as printed) though the fund's function is streets/highways. Judgment call, already marked review.
